[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Option 2: Spreadsheet** - Creating a table with columns for Movie Title, Release Year, Watch Date, Rating, Notes, Franchise/Series, Genre, Format, and Re-watch.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Option 3: Movie Tracking Apps** - Suggested apps like Letterboxd, IMDb Watchlist, FilmAffinity, and Cinema Clock for tracking movie watching history.
